title: Potato peel-based PBS/PBAT biocomposites: influence of composition and filler content on injection molded properties
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,2308-2320
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00333D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Susanna Miescher, Florine Schleiffer, Eliane Wegenstein, Selçuk Yildirim
Potato peels, an underused agro-industrial by-product, were added into PBS, PBAT, and their blends (30–90 wt%) to study how filler content and polymer composition affect the properties of injection-molded composites.
